title: IKEA Ladda Rechargeable Batteries AAA 750mAh $12.99/4-Pack + Delivery ($5 C&C under $50/ $0 for Member/ in-Store) @ IKEA
body:
Deal: IKEA Ladda Rechargeable Batteries AAA 750mAh $12.99/4-Pack + Delivery ($5 C&C under $50/ $0 for Member/ in-Store) @ IKEA

[DOGGYWOWWOW] The last batch of 1900mAh AA I got were still made in Japan. Likely the same for the others.
[Tacooo] This is standard price. Not a bargain. They've also had stock for months, they just weren't listed on the website.
[87percent] Think more that it’s been out of stock for a long time
[DOGGYWOWWOW] My local IKEA didn't have stock and I've been checking for months, and you're right the product page was pulled off the website for months too.
[87percent] @DOGGYWOWWOW: Springvale didn’t have stock for ages. On recently they’ve gotten AA back in stock
[peter05] @87percent: can you define how recently they didn't have stock and when they recently restocked?
[CodeXD] Last I checked earlier this year, there was only one store with stock in Victoria. Now it is back every store
[dav3] Adelaide didn't seem to have them for a while, but had plenty of AA batteries, I ended up grabbing them from Amazon.
[sav11] @dav3: Not the Ladda's from Amazon though right? Did you get Eneloops or something?
Ikea charge ridiculous fees for shipping where I am so I haven't been able to take advantage of the good pricing. I haven't seen Ladda's on Amazon so I've been buying Eneloop Pro's when they're on sale.
[penguinswillrise] The AAA wasn't listed on the website for months despite stock tracker showing availability.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] This is standard price. Not a bargain. They've also had stock for months,
yes I found endless pile of them every time I went in store recently.
might be they don't show stock online because customers kept on C&Cing just LADDA's, and not coming into the store.
[Tacooo] I always forget I'm browsing OzInStock not OzBargain.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] their batteries are good quality product at decent price so I think they are really meant to attract people to the store, and then they hope they grab something else on the way out.
they probably got sick of people just C&Cing 2 or 3 packs of LADDA's making them go out of stock quickly, and not buying anything else.
[Fappy Bunny] compare to any other shitty low quality rechargable battery, this is a bargain.
[BestTechAdvisor] $19.90 for Amazon Basics 12-Pack Rechargeable AAA NiMH Performance Batteries, 800 mAh, 1.2V
[DOGGYWOWWOW] Ok if you don't mind made in china.
Disgruntled customer when Amazon switched from made in Japan to China
[BestTechAdvisor] I'm happy with Chinese batteries in 2026.
for all I know the Chinese batteries could be better than the Japanese batteries but that isn't the issue
The disgruntled customer wasn't disgruntled due to performance, just due to the incorrect labelling. LADDAS and Eneloops are made in the same factory in Japan, so you do know what you're getting there, but the Amazon Basics are much better value and they have 4.5 stars out of 140k reviews.
[WatchNerd] Did you miss out 2 weeks ago when Amazon Basics were 16-Pack AAA for $15.89?
[BestTechAdvisor] @WatchNerd: That's a great deal!
I'm currently only using lithium batteries. Both have their pros and cons though so I might get some NiMH batteries for my camera gear in the future.
[sav11] @BestTechAdvisor: Yep I'm just starting out getting lithium batteries to complement my Eneloops. Bought some Xstar ones in the recent deals.
Which lithium batteries do you have? What are their cons compared to NiMH?
[BestTechAdvisor] @sav11:
Which lithium batteries do you have?
Imuto. From memory, Imuto come out of the same factory as Xstar in China.
What are their cons compared to NiMH?
Lithium cons: costs more, more of a fire hazard, goes flat / voltage drops suddenly.
Lithium pros: lighter, faster charging, higher consistent 1.5V.
[sav11] @BestTechAdvisor: Thanks! Appreciate the reply and info.
Imuto were the other one's I was looking at. I'll give them a shot next.
[aussieprepper] The Amazon pro cells are made by FDK but I haven't seen any for sale for ages.
[boretentsu] Gave up waiting and just got some Chinese ones on Amazon during prime. Worked out to be less than $1/pc.
[AdrianW] I'd probably get some - but my local Ikea isn't actually local and I also hate going in that store.
[muddrex] I just got some 2450mAh AA ones over the weekend.
[kmish] There is also this for sale https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B077PM1G2H?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_f…
$16.20 S&S. Comes with 2x AA and 2x AAA rechargables, so you may want to buy a 2nd set of rechargable AA's
[sav11] I have those and in my experience they are sh!t compared to Eneloops/Laddas. All 4 of them have died with minimal use in around 2 years. I have dozens of Eneloops, AA and AAA standard and Pro's, for around 10 years of minimal to average usage, and only 1 of the standard AA's has died.
Maybe I got a dodgy batch. I haven't had any other experience with those rechargeables so YMMV.
[aussieprepper] I have a bunch of cells the same age as yours and they seem okay and hold charge, When under load they are terrible. I was getting very low amperage out of them compared to new cells. The older cells would doing 1amp while the new cells are doing 3 amps with the same light. Measured with a clamp meter. Most of the pro NiMHs should be capable of doing 10amps.
[Jighuv] You should make a section for "loss leaders" then people can stop complaining when these good ongoing deals are posted like McDonalds $2 (now $2.50) Burger, or these batteries. Then everybody can know about loss leaders without the complaining.
[JaxSantiago] Thanks. Was at IKEA in Rhodes last week. They did have AAA and AA but only the 1900mAH ones. Now I can see they have 2450s in stock. Order placed.
[muddrex] I was there on Sunday and they have 2450s in stock (got some myself)
[JaxSantiago] Ugh. Tough luck. We were there Monday, 13th.
[pegasusx] Was there, but couldnt find them. It said the Aisle number was CASH COUNTER?
[Dubknee] Thanks OP, now I can stop borrowing the ones they keep in battery operated display stock.
[Some Random Guy] Have been in stock at Adelaide for literally forever.
I wish they brought back the lithiums :(
